observations: Actual white/plale plaster and red brick arched school is a different architectural block from the northeast cream Renaissance school within the same municipal BID. One generic facade across both would be incorrect.

The selected recessed upper plane has nine round-headed tall windows in three groups of three, with a row of smaller round-headed windows below. The front porch partly occludes the smaller lower row from the public street.
Red brick arches and a small corbelled brick top frieze frame original muted green-grey glazing; no copied shadows, reflections, tree pixels or school lettering.

Window rows remain at native-top-relative horizontal elevations. The selected wall begins above14.577m and contains no ground door. Nine native visual/HCOL floor samples2m outward were actually matched (8.0799..8.4167m); no missing floor assumption is needed.
limitations: Only the exact two triangles286/287,298.379m², of this complete recessed upper support plane are authored. Entrance porch, street wings, other historic block, courts and roofs remain pending.
Original window/brick sizes and colours approximate the actual rhythm within exact existing source dimensions; no survey accuracy is claimed.
All native geometry and winding remain unchanged; no foreground occluder, sign or photograph is redistributed. Runtime and fresh final integration still required.
